routes.detail: SafeRoute wraps the lazy ActionCenter page; lazy import is at line 228. Actual authenticated route mount was not exercised.

purpose: Prioritized decision inbox derived from existing evidence, with source coverage, recommendation explanations and reversible inbox-state decisions.
primaryGoal: Review ranked recommendations, inspect evidence and source limitations, open the source, then acknowledge, snooze, dismiss or restore inbox state without controlling the vehicle.

dataSources.owner: actionCenterHandler.List; implementation and providers not inspected
dataSources.contract: Typed ActionCenterResponse: items, total, limit, offset, generated_at, summary and provider_status. Query key includes filter; signal is forwarded. Query parameters are vehicle_id, priority, source_feature, state, limit and offset.
dataSources.limits: Backend calculations, aggregation coverage, authorization and actual response payloads are unverified. Summary describes provider-specific windows and counts before priority/source/state/pagination filters; this is frontend copy, not independent backend proof.

dataSources.contract: Recommendation-specific key, encoded ID, open-only enablement and cancellation signal. Exposes items and total; presentation currently renders only the first 25 events.

requiresLiveMode, networkMode always, fingerprint, action, expected_version, confirmed and snoozed_until; cancel list queries, snapshot/optimistic state update, rollback on failure, authoritative replacement on success, list/history invalidation.
dataSources.limits: Server-side concurrency, mutation outcomes and rate limiting were not exercised; router shows LimitByIP(30, time.Minute) at line 3921.

dataSources.owner: Existing selected-vehicle store and useVehicles dependency
dataSources.contract: Path/query/store/first-vehicle precedence; setter writes persisted selection and URL. Returns vehicles as an array, but does not expose fleet loading/error to this page. Underlying vehicle endpoint was not traced.
dataSources.limits: Header vehicle scope is intentionally disabled on /action-center; local vehicle selection must be retained. The route is not range-enabled and the inspected inbox hook has no date bounds; do not add an invented date filter.

dataSources.owner: Existing trust adapter and operational-mode context
dataSources.contract: Main list uses inferred provenance, fatalError and retained-data warning. Operational mode disables inbox mutations for cached/as-of views; navigation remains available. No new query-state, preference or authorization owner is needed.

components.name: PageLayout
components.usage: Title/subtitle, query, copyLink and refresh/provenance secondary actions. Preserve existing migrated layout; internals not inspected.

components.name: OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics
components.usage: Existing migrated six-count summary, source scope, generated time, provenance and narrative. Preserve raw metrics and current bridge; no replacement KPI system.

components.name: OperationalNarrativeDetails
components.usage: Recommendation rationale, confidence basis, limitations, evidence records and provenance. Internals not inspected.

components.name: Button/Select/Badge/GlassPanel/Pagination/Accordion/ConfirmDialog
components.usage: Reuse category barrel and existing APIs. Button supports wrapLabel and native attributes; Select supports explicit IDs and native labels; Pagination has mobile container rules and 44px controls; ConfirmDialog owns pending cancellation/loading guards.

components.name: Skeleton/QueryError/EmptyState/StaleRefreshWarning/useToast
components.usage: Existing loading, recovery, retained-data and success/error/undo feedback; no second toast or error framework.

components.name: FadeIn
components.usage: Four entrance wrappers; existing reduced-motion path uses initial=false and preference-derived duration. Browser behavior unverified.

components.name: ActionCenterFilters/ActionCenterSummary/ProviderStatusPanel/RecommendationList/RecommendationCard/RecommendationDetails/ActionConfirmation
components.usage: Page-specific orchestration/presentation; keep domain logic here and preserve extracted architecture.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Two hand-styled rank/confidence tiles repeat local surface, label and value presentation beside an already-migrated shared operational summary.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Evaluate existing numeric StatStrip/StatGroup or typography/surface primitives; keep rank score, rounded confidence percent and confidence label. Do not recalculate rank or replace supported specialist semantics with generic metrics.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Provider rows and rank tiles independently author rounded fixed-white sub-surfaces.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse current neutral surface tokens/primitives, not a new universal provider-card composite. No second independent production consumer was inspected to justify a new shared component.

sourceStrategy: Filters stack at base, become two columns at sm and four at xl (ActionCenterFilters.tsx:80).
Provider rows use one column then two at md (ProviderStatusPanel.tsx:46).
Recommendation header stacks until lg; actions wrap (RecommendationCard.tsx:67,118).
Pagination uses container queries and mobile 44px controls (Pagination.tsx:46-50).

issues.detail: min-w-48 score group plus p-6 card padding and fixed-size action labels needs narrow-container/long-content review. No overflow or clipping is claimed from source alone.
issues.fix: Exercise all ten contract widths, allocated shell widths, 200% text, RTL and long titles/labels; retain all evidence and actions. Use existing wrapLabel and min-w-0/wrapping APIs as needed.

sourceStrengths: Named summary/list/details sections and article title association; decorative action/refresh icons use aria-hidden.
Select uses native label association and focus-visible treatment; shared Button has focus and aria-busy.
Priority/state/provider labels accompany color; Accordion and ConfirmDialog are reused rather than independently implemented.
Existing FadeIn reduced-motion source retained; actual keyboard, modal focus restoration and screen-reader announcements untested.

issues.detail: Recommendation actions use size=sm (Button.tsx:38 h-9, 36px); filter clear uses the same size (ActionCenterFilters.tsx:76). This is below the contract's stronger 44px mobile default; WCAG failure is not asserted without spacing measurement.
issues.fix: Use existing Button className/wrapLabel to provide min-h-11 on mobile without losing labels or increasing desktop defaults globally; test pointer spacing and keyboard focus.

issues.detail: Read-only reason is provided only through title on disabled buttons, which shared Button removes from pointer interaction and native disabled controls remove from normal tab order.
issues.fix: Render a localized visible reason adjacent to the action group and associate it with the group; keep disabled buttons and existing live-mode guard.

issues.detail: Implicit Select identity still derives from translated labels. ActionCenterFilters supplies labels without explicit IDs (line 81); identity can change on language change. Duplicate IDs are a general shared risk, not proven for this page's four distinct labels.
issues.fix: Shared owner should review stable useId fallback consistent with current Input/Textarea migration, preserving explicit caller IDs, help and descriptions; alternatively explicit stable page IDs can bound this page's identity. Do not rewrite global selectors or persistence.

states.initialLoading: Summary receives loading only without retained data; provider skeleton and two recommendation-card skeletons remain visible. Filters and pagination mount independently.
states.empty: RecommendationList.tsx:54-64 supplies Inbox clear, filter explanation and clear action; provider panel separately explains absent status; summary passes undefined raw values, not fabricated zeros.
states.fatalError: Page passes actionCenterState.fatalError to RecommendationList and offers refetch; summary and provider sections remain mounted.
states.refreshFailure: Main page uses StaleRefreshWarning and preserves query.data and actions (ActionCenterPage.tsx:197-233). Existing tests describe this behavior but were not executed.
states.partialUnavailable: Summary maps missing summary or incomplete provider coverage to unavailable/partial (ActionCenterSummary.tsx:69-75); provider available/degraded/unavailable statuses and limitations remain.
states.offlineReadOnly: OperationalModeProvider.tsx:72-87 disables writes in cached mode; card buttons are disabled, source navigation stays available. Shell offline presentation was not inspected.
states.mutation: Confirmation stays pending while mutation isPending; success toast, 5-second undo affordance and error toast are preserved. Snooze means exactly 24 hours in page source.

issues.detail: History branches on history.error before rendering retained history.data, so a failed background refresh replaces usable history with QueryError.
issues.fix: Use existing useDataState(history), fatalError and StaleRefreshWarning for the history section; retain events and individual retry. No shared trust API change is necessary.

issues.detail: Pagination always receives total ?? 0, displaying a zero-result count during initial loading/fatal failure even though total is unknown.
issues.fix: Keep pagination capability but suppress/skeleton its count until a response exists; retain old count on refresh failure. Use existing loading/trust source, not zero as missing data.

visualIssues.detail: Every recommendation requests cyan or purple glow/hover chrome, including ordinary items. GlassPanel.tsx:31-35 shows this now means tinted hover borders, NOT a demonstrated luminous bloom; do not misreport a neon shadow.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer neutral hover borders, reserving semantic priority communication for labeled badges. Retain user-selected themes and shared GlassPanel migration.

visualIssues.detail: Rank and confidence both use bright fixed cyan-200; scoring repeats cyan-300 in RecommendationDetails.tsx:157 and provider icon uses cyan-300 at ProviderStatusPanel.tsx:30. Neutral informational values gain excessive accent emphasis and bypass theme text roles.
visualIssues.fix: Use shared metric/typography roles and semantic token emphasis only where needed; retain numeric values, confidence label and rank basis. Effective contrast and perceived saturation need rendered theme review.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed-white border/background decoration here and RecommendationCard.tsx:102,106 bypasses neutral theme surfaces; provider limitations use fixed bright amber-200 at line 69. These are translucent white treatments, not pure-white text. No literal neon class or text-white was found in the bounded page/components scan.
visualIssues.fix: Use current surface/border/text roles; keep semantic limitation status without making every limitation luminous. Preserve all limitations and provider findings.

visualIssues.detail: Hand-authored h3/p typography and repeated text-size/weight classes bypass existing role wrappers; ProviderStatusPanel.tsx:53,63,69 does the same. Shared OperationalBrief migration should not be reverted to match these local tiles.
visualIssues.fix: Use Heading/Text/PanelTitle/Caption/MetricValue as applicable with semantic as overrides; preserve article IDs and section hierarchy.

visualIssues.detail: ActionConfirmation.tsx:32 uses warning for every state change, including restore. Shared warning confirmation uses solid amber-500 plus text-primary, not a dedicated on-accent role; saturated emphasis and composed contrast require review, not an assumed contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should review warning foreground/chrome while retaining warning semantics and all confirmation/loading/focus behavior. Do not add a speculative new dialog variant from one page alone.

architectureIssues.detail: Local concrete vehicle choice writes global store/URL, but All vehicles and both clear paths remove only filter.vehicle_id (ActionCenterFilters.tsx:70,87; page:233). useSelectedVehicle still retains a concrete ID. Returning to the route seeds that persisted vehicle, potentially disagreeing with the previous all-vehicle inbox scope.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve the intended fleet-local selector contract without removing it: header scope is explicitly disabled. Define whether local changes should affect global selection, and preserve all-vehicle selection/clear semantics; test clearing, navigation away/back and URL synchronization. Do not simply call setVehicleId(null), because the hook falls back to the first vehicle.

architectureIssues.detail: Projected risk_level is appended as a raw enum in an otherwise localized impact list; cost uses Intl locale undefined (line 22) and a raw minor-unit fallback (line 27), not the current shared preference bridge.
architectureIssues.fix: Localize risk enum through existing catalogs and assess existing formatting/currency APIs without changing cost_minor wire values or inventing currency precision. Preserve unsupported currency fallback explicitly; backend currency conventions were not verified.

architectureIssues.detail: History request is fixed to 25/0 and details ignore history.total. Recommendation freshness, related_sources and source_url are typed but not rendered by the inspected feature. This is an existing coverage limitation, not permission to erase currently displayed content or claim full history.
architectureIssues.fix: Record these limits for integration ownership; preserve existing first-page history and navigation behavior. Do not expand hooks/backend capability during presentation-only work without assignment.

priority.reason: Protect retained action history and unknown result counts first; then correct scope synchronization and read-only reason accessibility. Visual cleanup is bounded because layout, operational summary, narrative, trust and motion foundations are already migrated.
order: mobile targets and accessible read-only explanation

requiredSharedChanges.detail: Current labeled implicit IDs remain translation-derived while the contract's Input/Textarea migration uses stable React identity.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Shared owner reviews stable useId fallback, with explicit ID compatibility and association regressions; page worker must not edit this shared primitive.
usedBy: ActionCenterFilters vehicle/priority/source/state fields (confirmed); additional consumers not inspected
dependsOn: focused real-i18n association tests and centralized validation
requiredSharedChanges.authorization: Reported requirement, not permission to expand this audit's write scope.

requiredSharedChanges.detail: Warning variant hardcodes saturated amber and theme-dependent primary text.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Review existing semantic warning/on-accent roles on actual themes before any shared adjustment; preserve API and safety behavior. No new composite/variant is justified by this one-page scope.
dependsOn: second independent consumer evidence before API expansion
existing Modal focus contract and regression preservation
requiredSharedChanges.authorization: Review candidate; no verified contrast failure and no speculative neutral variant request.

competingImplementations.detail: Local rank/confidence tiles coexist with the existing operational metric bridge used by the summary.
competingImplementations.fix: Prefer proven shared metric/typography support; keep specialist semantics if equivalence is unproved. No new stats implementation.

preservation.hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of exact page bytes via Get-FileHash
preservation.sectionCountDefinition: Four always-mounted major content groups; auxiliary header, pagination and conditional confirmation counted separately. Recommendation details contain three named subordinate sections plus narrative.

sections.name: Decision queue overview
sections.preserve: Six raw state/priority counts, missing versus zero, generated time, vehicle scope, before-filter scope, provider-window limitation, trust/provenance and review-details narrative.

sections.name: Filter decisions
sections.preserve: Vehicle including All vehicles; four priorities; nine source features; open/acknowledged/snoozed/dismissed/all states; clear action.

sections.name: Source coverage
sections.preserve: Every returned provider status, finding count, all limitations, skeleton and absent-status explanation.

sections.name: Prioritized recommendations
sections.preserve: Every returned card, priority/source/state/impact badge, title/summary/rationale, vehicle/expiry, raw rank, confidence percent/label and safe state actions.

actions: Refresh evidence/refetch and fatal list retry
Select vehicle/priority/source/state and clear filters from toolbar or empty state
Change page and page size (25/50/100), preserving limit/offset
Open/close summary review details through existing OperationalBrief
Acknowledge, snooze exactly 24 hours, dismiss or restore when safe_actions/current state allow
Open source navigation_path only when navigate is a safe action
Confirm/cancel action; keep dialog busy during mutation
Undo non-restore success with returned fingerprint/version; report undo success/error
dataBehavior: Keep initial state=open, limit=50, offset=0 and selected vehicle initialization.
Retain vehicle-change offset reset and filter/page-size offset semantics until explicitly reviewed integration fix.
Keep typed snake_case payloads, SI energy_wh/time_s and cost_minor/currency untouched in hooks/cache; energy display uses useUnits.
Keep inferred trust, returned generation time, partial coverage disclosure and unknown summary values distinct from zero.
Keep query keys, cancellation signals, history enablement, optimistic snapshots/rollback, version concurrency fields and list/history invalidation.
Keep existing read-only guard, live-mode request requirement and source-only navigation.

Preserve all current modernization: PageLayout, OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics, OperationalNarrativeDetails, category barrels, data-trust adapter, reduced-motion primitive and shared dialogs/pagination.
